The '''Graador sector''' was a sector in the extreme southwestern [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It bordered [[Corbett sector/Legends|Corbett]], [[Almak sector/Legends|Almak]], and [[Aldino sector/Legends|Aldino sectors]] in the Mid Rim, and [[Bri'ahl sector/Legends|Bri'ahl sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
